rationale: Although HOG shows strong session momentum (3.66x relative volume, trading above VWAP and the 5m 9-EMA), the most recent 1-minute candles show steadily declining volume on the push toward $33.29 followed by a red reversal candle on expanding volume. Shorting against a strong broad market and strong intraday trend is unfavorable, while entering long near the top of the range (89.9%) as immediate buying pressure wanes offers poor reward-to-risk. Furthermore, with 9 open positions already utilizing ~70% of buying power, preserving capital for a clearer setup is warranted.
